risk_note: RV2 (platform aliyun signer and SMS config, notification SMS channel, app.module wiring; agent signer re-export RV1). D10-315: no Aliyun SDK; the ACS3-HMAC-SHA256 signer of B3-03m moves to platform (agent re-exports the same function, frozen agent signer tests unchanged) and is checked verbatim against the official V3 document example. notification implements SendSms (Dysmsapi 2017-05-25, RPC, parameters in the query) as the resilience SmsChannel: OK with BizId is accepted, a parsed non-OK code below HTTP 500 is a definite rejection, 429 / 5xx / non-JSON / network / abort are channel failures; the verify-code sender maps only definite rejections (or all attempts circuit_open) to rejected and everything else to unknown, so a send that may have left is never released, and nothing is resent (no backup registered). Sign name and template code come from a lookup by code (SMS_CODE -> deploy config), prepared for D10-316. Credentials only via SMS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / SMS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET / SMS_SIGN_NAME / SMS_TEMPLATE_VERIFY_CODE (declared, local / test refuse to start when set); staging / prod use the live channel only with all four, else the existing rejecting sender and startup warn; no value is logged. Template text 5 minutes pinned to BR-ID-05 SMS_CODE_LIFETIME_SECONDS. No money, no attribution, no migration.
